ProfileInformation.Description:
Multi Panel(special function):

-REV: Lvl chg

-NAV: short press LNAV; long press VNAV

-IAS: long press SPD INTV

-ALT: long press ALT INTV

-AP: short press activate/deactivate AP A; long press press activate/deactivate AP B

-APR: short press activate/deactivate APP; long press activate/deactivate VORLOC

-Auto throttle lever: FD on/off

===============

Switch Panel (special function):

-Master Alt.:APU ON/OFF

-Cowl: Dome light

-OFF, R, L, Both/All, Start: Change range of ND

-Fuel pump: If fuel center tank quantity is equal 0 the fuel pumps center L and R ramain to off

================

RadioPanel:

- on XPDR mode long press ACT/STBY button active or disactive trasponder, short press ACT/STBY button(only upper button)switch to MB/HPA pressure

- on COM2long press ACT/STBY button swap and activate radio COM2 useful on IVAO, and the same for COM1

- Upper right display show FPS

===============

TCA 320 (Pilot):

-Parking brake on/off button 14

-Spoilers Arm button 8

-No Smoking button 7

-Seat Belts button 9

-External Power button 10

-Set baro button11

-Standard baro button 12

-HUD activate/deactivate button13

-Wing light button 16

===============

TCA Q Eng 1&2

-Left throttle button: A/T Arm/disarm

-Right throtlle button: TOGA

-IGN/START: Engine start 1&2 CONT

-Mode Norm: Engine start 1&2 OFF

-Left black button: Engine 1 GRD

-Right black button: Engine 2 GRD

-ENG1 lever: Engine 1 start idle/cutoff

-ENG2 lever: Engine 2 start idle/cutoff
